title: Missing moeb tool: ToolSearch (deferred schema loading)
description: ToolSearch called multiple times to load deferred MCP tool schemas before implementation could begin. No moeb equivalent exists for loading deferred tool schemas in the Claude Code environment. Causes moeb-tool-origin to fail on every run.
proposed_resolution: Pre-include required tool schemas in start_run and start_spec output, or introduce a schema-preload mechanism that eliminates ToolSearch calls during moeb runs.
